instructions.content: Identify the evidence scope first: determine which artifact type(s) (screenshot, log, script output) suit the task.
Capture screenshots with playwright-mcp using page.screenshot() and a path under the evidence directory.
Capture screenshots with the agent-browser screenshot action, saving to the evidence directory.
Capture logs by piping to tee and saving to the evidence directory as .txt files.
Capture script output by redirecting stdout/stderr (2>&1 | tee) to the evidence directory.
Name artifacts YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.<ext> with today's date and a kebab-case slug.
ALWAYS append an Evidence summary table with artifact path and description to the response when artifacts are created.
NEVER describe what you observed without saving an artifact; prose summaries are not verifiable.
NEVER use vague slugs such as screenshot1.png; use descriptive kebab-case names.
NEVER skip evidence capture when the task involves external state; it cannot be re-observed later.
Store artifacts under .context/evidence/ with date-prefixed filenames by default.
Verify the artifacts were written by listing the evidence directory with ls -lh.
Check for a project-specific evidence location (for example an entry-named assets directory) before defaulting to .context/evidence/.
Check that screenshots are valid images with the file command.
Do not capture evidence for purely generative tasks where no external state was observed, or when the user has said artifacts are not needed.
